place.title: Place {ref} ({ohms} resistor)
place.text: Put the {ohms} resistor {ref} with one leg in hole {holes.0} and the other in hole {holes.1}.
place.tip: Its color bands read {bands}. Direction doesn't matter.

why: {ref} limits how much current can flow in this part of the circuit.
whyPullUp: {ref} is a pull-up resistor: it holds {part}'s data line at 3.3 V while nothing pulls it low. {part} can only pull that line low to send its answer, so without {ref} the Pico couldn't read it.
whyWithLed: {ref} limits the current through {led} to about {ma} mA ((3.3 V − {vf} V) ÷ {ohms}). Without it, too much current would flow and could damage the LED or the Pico pin.
